gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.654322 40.146491)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
aspect_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(a.rast, 1, o.pt) AS aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_rast a, origin o;

WITH park_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM parks
  WHERE id = 251066
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      1,
      park_geom.geometry::geometry,
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r,
       park_geom
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, park_geom.geometry::geometry)
),
aspect_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(clipped_rast, 1) AS aspect_rast
  FROM dem_clip
),
aspect_avg AS (
  SELECT degrees(ST_StatsSingleBand(aspect_rast, 1, TRUE).mean) AS mean_aspect_degrees
  FROM aspect_rast
)
SELECT 
  CASE
    WHEN mean_aspect_degrees BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5 THEN 'Northeast'
    WHEN mean_aspect_degrees BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5 THEN 'East'
    WHEN mean_aspect_degrees BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5 THEN 'Southeast'
    WHEN mean_aspect_degrees BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5 THEN 'South'
    WHEN mean_aspect_degrees BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5 THEN 'Southwest'
    WHEN mean_aspect_degrees BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5 THEN 'West'
    WHEN mean_aspect_degrees BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5 THEN 'Northwest'
    ELSE 'North'
  END AS compass_bearing
FROM aspect_avg;
